risks.proof: “About”/spec page showing resolution, or a settings screen confirming 4K support.

risks.risk: Panel issues not visible in photos (lines, backlight dimming, burn-in, dead pixels) or intermittent faults.
risks.proof: Short video showing: full-screen solid colors (red/green/blue/white/black), scrolling text, and a quick HDMI test; plus power-on/off test.
